latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of datalens-web-scraper skill.

- Enables structured data extraction from any website open in Chrome using DataLens MCP tools.
- Provides a clear, step-by-step scraping workflow covering table detection, column analysis, job start, status polling, and data export.
- Outlines prerequisite setup for required npm packages, Chrome extension, and Node.js.
- Supports browser tab management and job control commands.
- Includes troubleshooting tools and explicit agent rules for correct operation.
